meta.one_liner: The legendary Turtle rules on ETFs: buy 40-day highs, exit 20-day lows, risk-managed with an ATR stop.
meta.explainer_md: In the 1980s, Richard Dennis taught a group of beginners — the 'Turtles' — a simple system that made many of them rich: buy anything breaking above its recent high, exit when it breaks below its recent low, and size positions by volatility. This version trades a diversified ETF basket (stocks, small caps, sectors, gold, bonds) with a 40-day-high entry, 20-day-low exit, and a 2-ATR stop, just like the original 'System 2'.
